title: poa glabrescens
intro: Poa glabrescens, commonly known as Smooth Meadow-grass, is a perennial grass species native to alpine regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Poa glabrescens include its use as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressive agent, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its bioactive constituents and their effects on the human body.
